pedagogical_depth.justification: All five lessons carry 4000+ char expanded_walkthroughs with paired misconceptions and recovery moves. Lesson 1: snapshot vs trend repair. Lesson 2: operator misconception of =. Lesson 3: operator-as-instruction. Lesson 4: variety of equivalence. Lesson 5: story-without-structure. Mid-unit and end-of-unit assessments present.

instructional_balance.justification: CRA progression: concrete (real balance scale), representational (drawn balance, sorting cards), abstract (equations, equivalent expressions). Lesson 5 capstone integrates all 3 expectations.

clarity_communication.justification: All lessons have substantial teacher_script, 4 expected_student_responses bands, paired misconceptions/recovery. Every lesson has 'I can' student_learning_goal.
